papers.title: 采样可达性分析的基本极限：几何与流畸变
papers.titleEn: Fundamental Limits of Sampling-Based Reachability: Geometry and Flow Distortion
papers.summary: 用有限轨迹端点估计可达集，究竟需要多少样本？本文把问题写成受动力学流畸变影响的几何支撑估计，以局部体积密度和单侧Lipschitz常数刻画尖角与收缩。作者给出Hausdorff误差的样本上界及有条件的极小极大下界，并用平面系统和机械臂实验说明维度负担；结论不涵盖自适应或利用模型结构的估计器。
papers.summaryEn: How many samples are needed to estimate a reachable set from finitely many trajectory endpoints? The paper formulates this as geometric support estimation under dynamical flow distortion, using local volume density and a one-sided Lipschitz constant to characterize corners and contraction. The authors give a sample upper bound for Hausdorff error and a conditional minimax lower bound, with planar and robot-arm experiments illustrating the dimensional burden. The results do not cover adaptive or model-aware estimators.
papers.whySelected: 为机器人安全验证提供失败边界：值得区分覆盖概率、凸包误差和真实可达集几何误差，而非只看采样数量。

xun.whyRead: 为机器人安全验证提供失败边界：值得区分覆盖概率、凸包误差和真实可达集几何误差，而非只看采样数量。
xun.relation: 机器人可达集估计与安全验证；补充非学习型控制理论研究。
prerequisites: 概率界与极小极大下界

limits: 下界针对独立同分布端点观测，并只在指定维度、局部密度、精度及状态域条件内成立，不是每个具体初始集合的逐点下界。
上下界还差维度相关因子及对数项；机械臂有限实验不认证渐近收敛率。
本稿为CoRL论文扩展并投稿TAC，不能写作TAC已录用。
assumptions: 初始集合有统一局部体积密度下界，采样密度有下界，向量场满足单侧Lipschitz条件。

papers.title: socx：基于JAX的GPU加速机会约束随机最优控制
papers.titleEn: socx: GPU-Accelerated Chance-Constrained Stochastic Optimal Control using JAX
papers.summary: 机会约束随机控制的凸重构常受计算和内存开销限制。socx利用ADMM把问题拆成可并行的线性二次跟踪与集合投影，并在JAX中实现。悬停线性化四旋翼仿真中，作者报告相对MOSEK最高98倍加速，并求解1120步时域；计时排除JIT编译，优势依赖硬件、容差和问题结构，不等于真实飞行验证。
papers.summaryEn: Convex reformulations of chance-constrained stochastic control can be limited by computation and memory. socx uses ADMM to split the problem into parallel linear-quadratic tracking and set projections, implemented in JAX. In hover-linearized quadrotor simulations, the authors report up to 98-fold speedup over MOSEK and solve a 1,120-step horizon. Timing excludes JIT compilation; gains depend on hardware, tolerance and problem structure, and do not constitute real-flight validation.
papers.whySelected: 适合关注机器人规划求解器与GPU并行化者；重点看结构分解如何降低单次求解成本，以及比较计时的边界。

prerequisites: 机会约束与协方差转向

limits: 实验为悬停线性化12维四旋翼模型，不能直接推出强非线性或实机性能。
报告硬件为Core Ultra 9 285K、64GB RAM、RTX 5080及16GB VRAM；socx计时不含JIT，基线比较内部求解时间。
最高加速比不适用于所有容差/时域，二次机会约束使用近似表述。

papers.title: 带定位约束的最优路径规划
papers.titleEn: Optimal Path Planning with Localization constraints
papers.summary: 没有GPS时，最短几何路径可能使无人机定位不确定性过大。本文将EKF传播的协方差界作为A*搜索的硬约束，利用已知地标观测限制漂移。作者在蒙特卡洛与PyBullet仿真中报告比所比较RRT*、PRM更短的可行路径。最优性应限定在表示了信念状态的可行图内；协方差约束不等于真实环境中的无条件安全保证。
papers.summaryEn: Without GPS, the geometrically shortest path may produce excessive localization uncertainty. This paper makes an EKF-propagated covariance bound a hard constraint in A* search, using known landmark observations to limit drift. The authors report shorter feasible paths than the compared RRT* and PRM planners in Monte Carlo and PyBullet simulations. Optimality should be confined to the feasible graph that represents belief state; a covariance constraint is not an unconditional safety guarantee in the real world.
papers.whySelected: 把定位质量纳入路径规划，适合对照学习几何最优与信念空间可行性的区别。

xun.whyRead: 把定位质量纳入路径规划，适合对照学习几何最优与信念空间可行性的区别。
xun.relation: 机器人导航中的规划—估计耦合；重点不是机械设计或通用视觉。

limits: 已知环境、障碍与地标位置；实验为二维网格和固定高度PyBullet飞行，未核验实机试验。
最优性证明依赖含均值与协方差的增广图及整段边可行性；不能把位置节点合并后的实现或连续空间最优性视为已证明。
协方差模型一致性与真实定位误差安全性不同；未独立复核代码实现。

papers.title: 穿越泊松森林的群体飞行：极限定理与最优策略
papers.titleEn: Limit Theorems and Optimal Policies for Flock Flight through Poisson Forests
papers.summary: 单机器人能否穿过森林，不等于群体每秒能通过多少。本文在泊松障碍场中构造有向走廊网络，以统一航点时间间隔约束交通，把最大通行率化为最小顶点割容量。作者证明重复使用顶点不相交路径可达到该协议下的容量，并研究尺度极限与准入队列稳定性；这不是任意连续轨迹的最优结论，也未提供实机群飞验证。
papers.summaryEn: Whether one robot can cross a forest does not determine how many can pass per second. This paper constructs a directed corridor network in a Poisson obstacle field and constrains traffic by a common waypoint headway, reducing maximum throughput to minimum vertex-cut capacity. The author proves that repeated use of vertex-disjoint paths attains capacity under this protocol, and studies scaling limits and admission-queue stability. This is not an optimality result for arbitrary continuous trajectories, nor a hardware swarm-flight validation.
papers.whySelected: 从单体避障转向群体吞吐瓶颈；可用最大流/最小割概念理解多机器人交通容量，不必先通读概率极限定理。

xun.whyRead: 从单体避障转向群体吞吐瓶颈；可用最大流/最小割概念理解多机器人交通容量，不必先通读概率极限定理。
xun.relation: 多机器人导航、拥塞与交通调度的理论基础。

limits: 容量精确性仅对预设前向走廊库和共同航点headway协议成立；对不受限制的连续飞行仅给可达下界。
统一前向速度、相同穿越时长和几何分离是调度证明关键，不能直接泛化至任意交叉路网。
正文为理论分析与示意图，未核验机器人实机实验；长篇渐近定理证明未完整审计。

papers.titleEn: Compositional Humanoid Manipulation through Isomorphic Teleoperation and Independent Skill Routing
papers.summary: 双臂技能的所有组合难以逐一示范。本文让左右臂在共享扩散专家池中独立路由，并以同构外骨骼采集接触操作数据。作者在G1上报告，换用外骨骼示范后，完整柜体流程成功率由35%升至65%。每条件仅20次测试，移动与操作分阶段执行，不能据此推断连续全身协同或跨机器人泛化。
papers.summaryEn: Demonstrating every combination of two-arm skills is impractical. This work routes each arm independently through a shared pool of diffusion experts and collects contact-manipulation data with an isomorphic exoskeleton. On G1, the authors report that switching to exoskeleton demonstrations raises full cabinet-workflow success from 35% to 65%. Each condition has only 20 trials, and locomotion and manipulation are staged; these results do not establish continuous whole-body coordination or cross-robot generalization.

papers.title: 寻找合取查询的最小见证
papers.titleEn: Finding Smallest Witnesses for Conjunctive Queries
papers.summary: 较早论文首次发现。若要保住全部查询答案，最少应保留哪些源元组？本文研究无自连接合取查询，以头聚类性质刻画精确求解的多项式可解性，并以头支配性质区分常数近似与对数不可近似边界。它提供保留目标的理论基线，可辅助理解更新计划为何需要保留某些见证；但不直接解决带本体约束的更新，也未验证交互系统或用户接受度。

papers.summaryEn: First discovery of an older paper. Which source tuples must be retained to preserve every query answer with minimum total size? For self-join-free conjunctive queries, the paper characterizes polynomial-time exact solvability using head-cluster structure and separates constant-factor approximation from logarithmic inapproximability using head domination. It offers a theoretical baseline for preservation goals and helps explain why update plans need certain witnesses, but does not directly solve ontology-constrained updates or validate an interactive system or user acceptance.

papers.title: 扩散策略：通过动作扩散学习视觉运动策略
papers.titleEn: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.summary: 这是2023年的基础经典，不是新论文。面对示范中多模态动作和时序一致性问题，扩散策略以视觉观测为条件，逐步去噪生成动作序列，再滚动执行前缀。作者在四类基准的12项任务上报告平均提升46.9%，但仍依赖示范覆盖，推理延迟也高于简单策略。适合用来理解本期双臂专家路由所沿用的动作生成基础。
papers.summaryEn: This is a foundational classic from 2023, not a new paper. To address multimodal actions and temporal consistency in demonstrations, Diffusion Policy conditions on visual observations, iteratively denoises an action sequence, and executes a prefix in a receding-horizon loop. The authors report an average improvement of 46.9% across 12 tasks from four benchmarks, but the method still depends on demonstration coverage and has higher inference latency than simpler policies. It provides the action-generation foundation for understanding this issue’s two-arm expert routing.
papers.whySelected: 周一额外基础经典：明确区分动作扩散、图像生成和动力学规划，是阅读当前扩散操作策略的直接概念支点。
